podcast.body: "Kryptonite" is a well-known song from Three Doors Down's multi-platinum debut album, "The Better Life." It contributed significantly to the album's success. "From Escatapa, Mississippi, population 3566, and it's three doors down with Kryptonite from their multi-platinum debut The Better Life, which is what they ended up with."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: "Superman" was the first song by Three Doors Down to gain attention, becoming a hit on a local radio station. This unexpected success helped spread their reputation beyond their hometown. "The first song they gained to any attention was Superman, which ended up being a hit on a local radio station. That sort of thing almost never happens."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
